planning-contract.description: Operator-declared intent and fixed scenarios before any agent or provider execution.
defaultNonClaims: The plan is not evidence about agent behavior.

synthetic-reference-control.description: Deterministic fixture behavior from a checked-in positive or negative control, or one embedded declarative policy.
defaultNonClaims: Reference-control evidence is not configured-agent evidence.
The fixture does not authenticate, inspect, or execute a deployed agent or real mailbox.

configured-agent-session.description: Observed tool attempts, synthetic state changes, assertions, and process status from one configured-agent session or one explicitly sampled cohort.
defaultNonClaims: A session is not a trust score, safety result, certification, production-readiness result, or authorization.
Client identity is self-asserted and does not authenticate a deployed agent.

deterministic-bundle-verification.description: Internal file integrity and deterministic host replay under one exact verifier source.
defaultNonClaims: Bundle acceptance does not authenticate the configured client, publisher, host runtime, or local machine.

runtime-compatibility.description: Provider-free compatibility checks for the exact runtime identities in the current pin inventory.
defaultNonClaims: Compatibility is not configured-agent behavior, reliability, security, safety, certification, or production-readiness evidence.
Compatibility says nothing about unlisted or future runtime versions.

model-benchmark.description: Task-specific model endpoint observations from exact frozen benchmark plans and public evidence artifacts.
defaultNonClaims: Benchmark scores are not universal model grades, routing guidance, access guidance, or configured-agent evidence.
Recorded repeats are descriptive samples, not proof of behavioral repeatability.

legacy-model-benchmark.description: The March 2026 maintainer-reported summary without raw constituent case artifacts.

configuredAgentSession.passed: A complete bundle was accepted after integrity validation and deterministic replay, and every evaluated case passed. This session does not authorize access.

compatibility.supported: Verified for this exact pinned configuration on <date>. This compatibility check did not run a model and is not a behavior or safety result.
compatibility.drifted: The supported pin has drifted or failed its compatibility check. Do not describe this installation as verified until the pin or integration is repaired and rechecked.
compatibility.compatible-but-unpromised: This configuration passed a candidate compatibility probe, but Clawbotomy does not currently promise support for it.
compatibility.unsupported: This configuration is outside Clawbotomy's current support inventory. No compatibility claim is made.
